name: tw-jobs-mcp
display_name: Taiwan Jobs 台灣求職搜尋
description: Search Taiwan jobs on 104, Yourator and foreign companies' career boards. 搜尋 104、Yourator 與外商職缺板的台灣職缺。
long_description:
Read-only MCP server for Taiwan job postings: 104, Yourator, and foreign companies' own Greenhouse / Lever / Workday career sites. Filter by keyword, area, job category, salary, job type, remote, recency, years of experience and education; read full postings and company profiles; estimate salary ranges. No account or API key needed.

唯讀的台灣求職搜尋，涵蓋 104、Yourator 與外商自家職缺板。可依關鍵字、地區、職類、薪資、工作性質、遠端、刊登時間、年資、學歷篩選，查看完整職缺與公司簡介，並估算薪資行情。不需要帳號或 API key。

Unofficial, not affiliated with 104. 非官方工具，與 104 無關。
